On 28 March 2025, two powerful earthquakes struck central Myanmar’s Sagaing Region near Mandalay.
The first, with a magnitude of 7.7, occurred at 12:50 p.m. local time, followed by a second of magnitude 6.4 at 1:02 p.m.
Multiple aftershocks have since been reported, disrupting ongoing rescue operations.
